scope: Additive Greedy Raven L1-10 resource-target and damage audit; preserve pinned per-level resource DPS without inventing target transitions.
game_version: Official 2026-02-23 introduction; dated game-file table 2026-09-01 and client 18.600.3 on 2026-09-18; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
facts: Greedy Raven unlocks at TH18/Pet House 12, is a long-range flying attacker, prioritizes resource buildings near its Hero and deals five times damage to those buildings.
sources.limitations: No exact near-Hero radius, resource-category boundary, target tie-break, fallback target, post-Hero-loss behavior, projectile or impact timing is specified.

sources.title: Cuervo avaricioso: costes, tiempos y niveles — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: The TH18 maximum is L10, and L1-10 HP and base DPS match the pinned payload; range is eight tiles and attack cadence 0.42 seconds.
sources.limitations: The page gives no resource-DPS table, target acquisition radius or paired-Hero lifecycle.

sources.title: Greedy Raven — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The game-file-derived page independently reports eight-tile range and matching HP/DPS values.
sources.limitations: No complete target selection or bonus-hit damage phase is supplied.

sources.title: Pinned Greedy Raven Home Village Pet record
facts: Every level contains dpsOnResourceBuildings equal to exactly five times its base damagePerSecond.
sources.limitations: The payload does not define the resource-building set, damage rounding per hit, projectile, exact client build or target transitions.

derivations.method: Lossless normalization of the SHA-pinned raw values; each equals the primary-source five-times base DPS claim. No per-impact damage or combat rule is inferred.

derivations.result: Confirm TH18 maximum L10 and dated HP/DPS
derivations.method: Compare two dated game-file-derived tables with the pinned raw levels.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat every building containing loot as a resource target
rejected_inferences.reason: The official description says resource buildings but does not enumerate Storage, Collector, Drill, Town Hall or event objects.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use an arbitrary four-tile near-Hero resource search radius
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source supplies an absolute radius.

rejected_inferences.rule: Multiply damagePerHit by five and round on impact
rejected_inferences.reason: The published five-times damage and raw DPS do not establish per-hit rounding, projectile impact or modifier order.

rejected_inferences.rule: Deploy Greedy Raven with generic Pet following and retargeting
rejected_inferences.reason: Paired spawn, follow, target loss and post-Hero-defeat ordering remain undocumented.

items: exact current client build and per-level resource DPS continuity
Hero-linked deployment, follow and post-Hero-loss transitions
near-Hero resource search radius and deterministic tie-break
per-hit multiplier, rounding and damage-modifier order
projectile launch, impact and target-loss timing
collision, visual anchors and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Greedy Raven L1-10 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official five-times resource damage and dated level values corroborate the pinned per-level resource DPS, but paired-Pet targeting and impact timing are not specified well enough for a faithful Core actor.
